name: Cassis

limits: For white wine, Clairette and Marsanne together: at least 60%
For white wine, Terret: at most 5%
For rosé wine, Cinsault, Grenache and Mourvèdre together: at least 70%
For rosé wine, Bourboulenc, Clairette, Marsanne, Pascal, Sauvignon Blanc and Ugni Blanc together: at most 20%
For rosé wine, Terret Noir: at most 5%
For red wine, Cinsault, Grenache and Mourvèdre together: at least 70%
For red wine, Terret Noir: at most 5%

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.

blurb.text: A Provence appellation in the commune of Cassis. Whites draw on Clairette and Marsanne, while reds and rosés draw on Cinsault, Grenache and Mourvèdre.
